# Collar City Tech Help

> Websites, security checkups and online-presence help for small businesses, based in Troy, NY. Work is done online for clients across the U.S.; around the Capital Region, Alex can also come by in person to take photos for a client's website. Run by Alex, founder, who has a background in cybersecurity. Plain-English, affordable, no access to client systems.

## What we offer
- Free homepage mockup: https://collarcitytechhelp.com/mockup/
- Websites: Starter $499 one-time (1 page, launched in 7 days), Business $999 one-time (up to 5 pages, launched in 14 days), Website Care $29/month. Clients own their site and domain. On-site photos +$149, Capital Region only: https://collarcitytechhelp.com/websites/
- Free 3-minute security quiz (10 yes/no questions, instant score): https://collarcitytechhelp.com/#quiz
- Security Scorecard, $79 one-time: 10-minute online questionnaire plus public DNS checks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX) on the business email domain. Written report by email within 2 business days: overall grade, top 5 risks, ordered fix list, free tools. 7-day refund.
- Done-for-You Online Presence, $99/month: 4 Google Business Profile posts, 8 social posts and review reply drafts each month. Cancel any time.
- Small Business Security + AI Starter Kit, $24 download.
- Free 10-minute security checklist: https://collarcitytechhelp.com/checklist/

## Who it is for
Small businesses with 1-20 staff: restaurants and cafes, salons and barbers, contractors, dental and medical offices, retail shops, real estate agents, accountants. Capital Region NY first (Troy, Albany, Schenectady, Cohoes, Watervliet, Waterford, Latham, Clifton Park, Saratoga Springs, East Greenbush); available anywhere in the U.S.

## Limits (stated honestly)
General guidance only, not legal or compliance advice (not a HIPAA/PCI service). No service can guarantee a business will never be hacked. We never ask for passwords and never log in to client systems. Work is prepared by Alex using modern tools, including AI, and checked before it is sent. Every website is personally reviewed before it goes live.
